test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 12th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence from Active to Passive Voice:

Why did the editor overlook the stylistic issues?

options.text: Why did the stylistic issues be overlooked by the editor?
Why have the stylistic issues been overlooked by the editor?
Why are the stylistic issues being overlooked by the editor?
Why were the stylistic issues overlooked by the editor?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Why did the editor overlook the stylistic issues?"
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the stylistic issues" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "did overlook" to "were overlooked" (past simple passive).
 
• Ensure the question form remains intact by starting with "Why."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Why were the stylistic issues overlooked by the editor?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Why did the stylistic issues be overlooked by the editor?" – Incorrect structure (verb "be" is improperly used).
 
• **Option 2: **"Why have the stylistic issues been overlooked by the editor?" – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"Why are the stylistic issues being overlooked by the editor?" – Incorrect tense (present continuous passive).
